name: CMIP6 Analysis-Ready Cloud Optimized (ARCO) simulations
model_or_instrument: 38 CMIP6 GCMs/ESMs (ACCESS-CM2, ACCESS-ESM1-5, CanESM5, EC-Earth3, MIROC6, MPI-ESM1-2-LR, etc.)
resolution: Original native ocean and atmospheric grids, interpolated to 1° x 1° and extracted at tide-gauge locations; monthly mean
